prompt: How many countries were part of the commonwealth on the date Prince Charles ascended?
answer:
There were **56 countries in the Commonwealth** when Prince Charles became king on **8 September 2022**.  

This was distinct from the **15 Commonwealth realms**—the United Kingdom plus 14 other countries—in which he became head of state.
